headline: Away sides sweep the day, Tampa and Florida Tech lead
dek: Tampa won at Barry and Florida Tech at Eckerd on a day when every match in the conference went to the visiting side, and they now stand level at the top with neither yet beaten in conference play. Tampa have lost once all season, in August, and have conceded eight goals.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and neither of those sides has yet taken a point in conference play.

wire.line: Every match on the day went to the side away from home; Tampa and Florida Tech lead the table, neither yet beaten by a conference rival.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result; Palm Beach Atlantic are party to all of them but Eckerd's home match of September 9.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored nine of Palm Beach Atlantic's fifteen goals this season, from 34 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Florida Tech have won five, drawn three and lost one, the defeat coming on the opening night at home.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded nineteen goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Henry Obi has made 42 saves for Barry without yet keeping a clean sheet.

last_match.line: Tampa are unbeaten since August and now level on points with Florida Tech; Barry have still not won at home.

next_match.line: Saint Leo are the only side to have beaten Florida Southern this season; Florida Southern have won every match since.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
